title: Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches
description: Algebra, functions, trigonometry, statistics and calculus, with an emphasis on proof and analytical thinking.

topics.title: Sequences and series
topics.summary: Arithmetic and geometric sequences, sums, sigma notation and financial applications.

topics.title: Exponents and logarithms
topics.summary: Laws of exponents and logarithms, change of base and exponential equations.

topics.title: Binomial theorem and proof
topics.summary: Binomial expansion and simple deductive proof.

topics.title: Counting principles and partial fractions
topics.summary: Permutations, combinations, extended binomial theorem and partial fractions.

topics.title: Complex numbers
topics.summary: Cartesian, polar and Euler forms, De Moivre’s theorem and roots of complex numbers.

topics.title: Proof and systems of equations
topics.summary: Induction, contradiction, counterexample and systems of linear equations.

topics.title: Lines and functions
topics.summary: Straight lines, domain and range, composite and inverse functions.

topics.title: Quadratics
topics.summary: Quadratic functions, the discriminant and solving quadratic equations and inequalities.

topics.title: Rational, exponential and logarithmic functions
topics.summary: Reciprocal and rational functions, asymptotes, exponential and logarithmic graphs.

topics.title: Transformations of graphs
topics.summary: Translations, stretches and reflections of graphs.

topics.title: Polynomials and further functions
topics.summary: Factor and remainder theorems, sums and products of roots, modulus and odd and even functions.

topics.title: Geometry in 3D and right triangles
topics.summary: Distance, midpoints, volume and surface area, and right-angled trigonometry.

topics.title: Sine and cosine rules
topics.summary: Non-right-angled triangles, area and bearings.

topics.title: Radians and circular functions
topics.summary: Radian measure, the unit circle, trigonometric graphs, identities and equations.

topics.title: Vectors
topics.summary: Vector algebra, scalar and vector products, lines and planes in 3D.

topics.title: Descriptive statistics
topics.summary: Sampling, measures of centre and spread, and statistical diagrams.

topics.title: Correlation and regression
topics.summary: Scatter diagrams, Pearson’s correlation coefficient and regression lines.

topics.title: Probability
topics.summary: Events, Venn and tree diagrams, conditional probability and independence.

topics.title: Probability distributions
topics.summary: Discrete random variables, the binomial and normal distributions.

topics.title: Bayes and continuous random variables
topics.summary: Bayes’ theorem, variance of discrete variables and continuous random variables.

topics.title: Introduction to differentiation
topics.summary: Limits, the derivative as a gradient and the power rule.

topics.title: Differentiation rules and applications
topics.summary: Chain, product and quotient rules; stationary points and optimisation.

topics.title: Integration
topics.summary: Antiderivatives, definite integrals, areas and kinematics.

topics.title: Further calculus
topics.summary: Limits and L’Hôpital’s rule, implicit differentiation, related rates and integration techniques.

topics.title: Differential equations and series
topics.summary: Separable and first-order equations, Euler’s method and Maclaurin series.
